correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the monitoring definition: x monitors xy because removal increases d(x,y)=1. For x=a_p and a nonincident edge a_r b_s, every target b_j (j!=p) retains its direct edge, every other a_q has n-2>=2 two-edge geodesics with at most one affected, and b_p has (n-1)(n-2) geodesics a_p-b_j-a_i-b_p with at least one avoiding the edge, including s=p. Thus only incident edges are monitored n>=4; by symmetry every monitoring set is a vertex cover. Independent set classification: subsets of A or B plus n matched pairs {a_i,b_i}; I(z)=2(1+z)^n-1+nz² and D(z)=z^(2n)I(z^-1). Minimum monitoring sets exactly A and B, cardinality n. For n=3 is C6 and its monitoring number is 2, so threshold sharp. Independent edge deletion and shortest-path recomputation for all probes and all vertex subsets checked n=3,4,5, including polynomials.
